title: Comfort Club Dues Billing and the Replacement System Installations Accessory Member Discount
content:
# Prepaid-dues points

**Rule.** The prepaid-dues points of the accessory member discount on a Replacement System Installations contract follow how the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement dues are billed and renewed, as shown on the agreement in the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements records:

| Dues billing | Automatic renewal | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| Annual | Set | 2 percentage points |
| Annual | Not set | 1 percentage point |
| Monthly | Set or not set | No prepaid-dues points |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical agreements)

- Dues billed annually with automatic renewal: 2 points.
- Dues billed annually, automatic renewal switched off: 1 point.
- Dues billed monthly with automatic renewal: no points — monthly billing adds none whatever the renewal setting.
